{{Quote|The last seat on this flight belongs to the Empire!|Stormtrooper|<ref name="Inside">{{WebCite|url=http://www.insidethemagic.net/2011/06/video-star-tours-2-grand-opening-at-disneyland-packs-star-wars-big-action-into-small-ceremony|text=Video: Star Tours 2 grand opening at Disneyland packs big Star Wars action into small ceremony|date=2011-06-04|author=Ricky Brigante|archivedate=20230329094549}}</ref>}}
'''Star Tours Flight 6311''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight bound for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The flight was fully booked by departure time, although a conflict broke out when both a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] both tried to check in at the same time, while there was only one ticket left. The brawl attracted the attention of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who intervened. Another [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] soon arrived, and won a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel (short story)|duel]] over Vader. At the end of it, Vader fled, and the Jedi was allowed boarding on the flight.

==Behind the scenes==
This flight was mentioned in a live grand opening ceremony for the new version of [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|''Star Tours'']] at [[Wikipedia:Disneyland|Disneyland]] on [[June 3]]rd, [[2011]]. The events surrounding that flight were also part of the ceremony, and not part of the attraction itself.
